column1: # Measurement: DC internal resistance (DCIR) from HPPC 10-s pulse
# Definition:  R0 = instantaneous ohmic drop only (sub-second response)
#              This is the correct R0 for use in Q_gen = I²·R(T)
#   "Integrated Equivalent Circuit and Thermal Model for Simulation
#    of Temperature-Dependent LiFePO4 Battery in Actual Embedded Application"
#   Method: R0 = (U_n - U_{n-1}) / I at 1 sample/second resolution
#   NOTE: Gao R0 includes fast RC dynamics within 1-s window → higher values
#         (~65–80 mΩ at 25°C) than Lin HPPC R0 (~10 mΩ).
#   No tabulated values are provided; digitisation from the 3D figure
#   at SOC=0.5 yields consistent temperature trend but higher absolute
#   values due to measurement resolution difference (see NOTE above).
